early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.wind: Title of the window while the game loads.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.useG: On: the background follows the game (red, or black with the dark Mojang Studios background option). Off: use the background color below.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.back: Only used when "Use game background" is off.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.text: Color of the text and of the bar borders.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.prog: Fill color of the loading progress bars.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.dyna: On: the memory bar goes from green to red as memory use grows. Off: use the memory bar color below.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.memo: Only used when "Memory bar: color by use" is off.
early-loading-screen.midnightconfig.show: The loading messages at the bottom left of the window.
